highlight.title: Cloud Run AI Agent Platform Integration
highlight.summary: Google Cloud introduces Cloud Run remote MCP server for AI agent deployment, enabling seamless integration with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. This preview feature streamlines agent development lifecycle from prototyping to production through automated infrastructure provisioning and CI/CD pipeline integration.

resources.title: Agents CLI Streamlines AI Development Lifecycle
resources.why_now: Google's new Agents CLI unifies fragmented agent development tooling by generating Infrastructure as Code, configuring CI/CD pipelines, and deploying directly to Cloud Run or Kubernetes. This reduces context overhead for coding assistants and makes agent-to-production workflows deterministic rather than manual.

resources.title: Expanded Compute Flexible CUD Coverage
resources.why_now: GCP automatically migrated all billing accounts to expanded Compute Flexible CUDs covering Compute Engine, GKE, and Cloud Run with the same commitment. This structural change eliminates the need for separate containerized workload commitments and can deliver 46% discounts on 3-year terms with zero upfront payment.

resources.title: Pub/Sub Direct BigQuery Integration Best Practices
resources.why_now: BigQuery subscriptions eliminate intermediate processing services for streaming analytics, enabling real-time data analysis within seconds of publishing. This pattern has become essential for IoT telemetry, event analytics, and audit logging where operational overhead reduction is critical.

resources.title: GCP IAM Security Hardening for 2026
resources.why_now: With hybrid cloud strategies dominating 2026, IAM Recommender and just-in-time access workflows have become essential. Short-lived privileges and time-stamped approval flows significantly reduce phishing attack windows and provide auditors with precise access tracking across multi-cloud environments.

claude_take: The AI agent deployment story on Cloud Run is compelling - Google is betting that infrastructure-as-code generation plus managed MCP servers will solve the notorious 'local prototype to production' gap that has plagued agent development. The expanded CUD coverage finally makes GCP commitment math straightforward for modern workloads mixing VMs, containers, and serverless.
